issues.t: Rear drive motor wiring can short, cutting power (recall)
issues.sym: A sudden loss of drive power while driving, usually with warning messages on the dash.
issues.why: Wires inside the rear drive unit motor were not insulated well enough and could touch each other, shorting the motor.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V320000. If you lose power, steer to a safe spot with hazards on. The dealer replaces the rear drive unit free.

issues.t: High-voltage battery part can come loose, fire risk (recall)
issues.sym: Often no warning. Watch for battery warnings, a burning smell, or smoke from under the truck.
issues.why: A component inside the high-voltage battery modules may not have been secured. It can move and damage the battery, raising the risk of a fire.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and call 911 if there are flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. Check your VIN for recall 26V494000 and follow GM's instructions on parking and charging until it's fixed. If you smell burning or see smoke, get everyone out and away and call 911.

issues.t: Steel wheels can crack at the vent holes (recall)
issues.sym: A vibration or wobble, a clicking from a wheel, or visible cracks around the holes in a steel wheel.
issues.why: A manufacturing defect can let steel wheels crack around their vent holes, and the center of the wheel could separate.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V496000. If you feel a new vibration or see cracks, stop driving and have the wheels inspected.

issues.t: Service High Voltage or Unable to Charge message
issues.sym: A Service High Voltage or Unable to Charge message, a check engine light, DC fast charging that won't start or charges much slower than before, or charging stopping well short of full.
issues.why: GM traced the 2024 version to battery software, moisture, snow or debris in the charge port, plugging in while not in Park, or a fault in the high-voltage insulation. Some 2025 owners report battery and charging faults that came back after repairs.
issues.next: Check the charge port for snow, ice or dirt and make sure the truck is in Park when plugging in. AC charging may still work if DC fast charging doesn't. Have a dealer check for code P2980 and install software updates.

issues.t: Rear door open sensors don't detect open doors
issues.sym: No door-open warning or dome light when a rear door is open, and the truck may lock itself with a person or key fob inside.
issues.why: Owners report faulty rear door ajar sensors to NHTSA; it is the most common 2024 complaint.
issues.next: Check the rear doors by hand before driving or walking away. Have a dealer test the door sensors and ask about software updates.

issues.t: Front trunk latch fault puts the truck in limp mode
issues.sym: A frunk-open warning even though it is shut, and the truck going into reduced power.
issues.why: The frunk latch or its sensor fails, so the truck thinks the frunk is open and limits driving.
issues.next: Open and firmly close the frunk again. If the warning stays, have the latch and sensor checked.

issues.t: Touchscreen, gauges or backup camera go black or freeze
issues.sym: The center screen or digital gauge cluster freezes or goes black, hiding speed and turn signals, or the backup camera image drops out.
issues.why: GM has bulletins for intermittent black radio screens and radio software updates, and owners report frozen clusters and camera blackouts.
issues.next: If the display freezes, pull over when safe; a restart often brings it back. Ask a dealer to install the latest software.

issues.t: OnStar or GPS stops working from a failed telematics module
issues.sym: OnStar, the SOS button, navigation or the phone app stop working, sometimes with a message that the service is unavailable.
issues.why: The telematics module fails. Owners report the replacement part being on backorder.
issues.next: Keep your phone handy for emergencies, since the SOS button may not work. Have the dealer confirm the module fault and order the part.

issues.t: Automatic emergency braking activates for no reason
issues.sym: The truck brakes hard by itself in traffic or while backing up when nothing is in the way.
issues.why: Owners report false automatic braking and parking-sensor braking to NHTSA. GM also has a bulletin on Forward Collision System Reduced messages.
issues.next: Keep the front camera and sensors clean. Report each event to the dealer and NHTSA, and ask about software updates.

issues.t: Power steering warning message from software
issues.sym: A power steering service message appears; steering may feel normal or heavier.
issues.why: GM has a bulletin for a software problem that sets a power steering message, with dealers clearing the code until updated software is released.
issues.next: If the steering suddenly turns heavy, grip the wheel with both hands, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — have it towed and checked. Have the dealer check for the steering software update.

issues.t: ABS warning from rubbed wheel speed sensor wiring
issues.sym: ABS, traction control or stability warning lights come on.
issues.why: GM has a bulletin for the ABS wiring harness rubbing on an edge of the drive unit and damaging the right rear wheel speed sensor wires.
issues.next: Normal braking should still work, but ABS may not. Have the dealer inspect and repair the harness.

issues.t: Truck won't power up from a low 12-volt battery
issues.sym: The truck won't turn on or respond to the key fob, or a low battery message appears.
issues.why: GM has bulletins on a possible low 12-volt battery no-start and on trucks that won't power up after a failed over-the-air update.
issues.next: Have the 12-volt battery tested and charged. If it happened after a software update, the dealer may need to reprogram modules.

issues.t: Soft tonneau cover comes loose at highway speed
issues.sym: The bed cover flaps, shrinks or pulls loose at highway speed; one owner had a crossbar fly off.
issues.why: Owners report the soft tonneau cover not staying secure.
issues.next: Check the cover's clamps and crossbars before highway trips. Remove it if it's loose, since flying parts can hit other cars.

issues.t: Roof antenna fin or weather stripping comes loose
issues.sym: The shark-fin antenna on the roof falls off or the door weather stripping comes loose.
issues.why: Owners report the roof antenna cover and trim not being attached well.
issues.next: Have the dealer reattach or replace it under warranty. Cover any opening to keep water out.

issues.t: Front seat belt buckle bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no sign; a buckle may feel loose.
issues.why: The bolts holding the front seat belt buckles may not have been tightened, so the belt may not hold in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 23V786000. The dealer tightens the bolts free.

issues.t: Rear center seat belt can be torn by the wrong trim piece (recall)
issues.sym: No warning sign.
issues.why: The wrong trim bezel was used on the second-row center seat belt and could cut the belt in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V087000. Don't use the rear center seat until it's fixed.

issues.t: Rear center seat belt bolt may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: No warning sign; the rear center belt may feel loose.
issues.why: The bolt attaching the rear center seat belt to the seat may not have been tightened.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V015000. The dealer tightens the bolt free.

issues.t: Pedestrian warning sound too quiet on Work Truck (recall)
issues.sym: People nearby may not hear the truck coming at low speed.
issues.why: On some 2025 Work Truck models, the pedestrian alert sound is quieter than federal rules require.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V937000. The dealer updates the body control software free. Watch for pedestrians in parking lots.

issues.t: Stability control warning light may not come on (recall)
issues.sym: No warning light even though the stability control system has a fault.
issues.why: Brake control software may not turn the stability control warning light back on at the next start after a fault.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V594000. It can be fixed by an over-the-air update or at a dealer.

issues.t: Electronic owner's manual may not download (recall)
issues.sym: The owner's manual isn't available on the center screen.
issues.why: The radio was not set up at the factory to download the electronic owner's manual.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V114000. The dealer resets the radio free.
